_meta.purpose: The UK eBay theme bank, measured from 400 live tee titles across t-shirt-junky and love_tshirts. `share` is the observed proportion of the catalogue. `keyword_bank` supplies the padding tokens that fill an eBay title to the 70-80 character band.
_meta.warning: This is NOT the US Etsy/Amazon market. The buyer here skews male, 35-65, British. Nurse/dachshund-mom/boho-arch niches do not map onto this audience.

themes.name: Funny / rude slogan
themes.audience: Self-purchase and gag gift; stag dos, birthdays, Secret Santa
observed_examples: Sarcasm T-Shirt Mens Funny Slogan The Elements Of My Personality Sarcastic Joke
Sons of Arthritis Funny Biker Motorcycle
I Found This Humerus Funny Slogan Humorous
Part Cotton Part Cat Hair Funny
themes.note: Highest-share theme. Short phrases are the most trademark-exposed content in the catalogue - screen every one.

themes.name: Biker / motorcycle
themes.audience: UK motorcyclists 35-65; cafe racer, chopper and classic-bike culture
observed_examples: Cafe Racer Biker Motorbike Motorcycle
BIKER T-SHIRT Motorbike Motorcycle Cafe Racer Chopper Bike Mens Funny Skull Top
Sons of Arthritis Funny Biker Motorcycle
Retirement Plan Biker Motorcycle Motorbike
themes.note: Never use a real marque - Harley, Triumph, Kawasaki, Yamaha are all live marks. Describe the machine, not the brand.

themes.name: Music & scene
themes.audience: Gig-goers, record collectors, scene loyalists across ska, punk, northern soul, reggae, metal
observed_examples: Cant Stop 2-Tone British SKA 2Tone
Northern Soul Keep The Faith Mens Music Vest Dance Motown MOD Scooter
Guitar Reflection Guitarist Bass Acoustic
Anarchy in the UK Punk Music Rock
themes.note: Design the SCENE, never the band. 'Northern Soul', '2-Tone Ska', 'Anarchy in the UK' are cultural movements; band names, logos and lyrics are not.

themes.name: Skull / gothic
themes.audience: Overlaps heavily with biker and metal; also Halloween and tattoo culture
observed_examples: Gothic Skull and Crow With Arch and Moon
Skull T-Shirt Mens Biker Tattoo Tribal Viking Demon Gym Heavy Metal Rock Death
Los Muertow Sugar Skull Day of the Dead
Moon & Crow Gothic Goth Vikings Skull Raven
themes.note: Highest cross-sell theme - stacks with biker, Viking and metal. Cheap to generate, deep demand.

themes.name: Flags & nationality
themes.audience: Patriots, diaspora communities, football fans, tourists
observed_examples: Distressed Union Jack Flag Great Britain
If This Flag Offends You Union Jack Britain
Torn Morocco Flag Moroccan Day Football
British Grown Jamaican Roots Jamaica Flag
themes.note: THE PUREST GRID THEME IN THE CATALOGUE. One flag treatment x ~200 countries x 4 variants (Torn / Curled / Love / Distressed) x 17 garments = 13,600 listings from ONE piece of art. This is how they scale, in plain sight.

themes.name: Animals & pets
themes.audience: Pet owners and wildlife enthusiasts; breed-specific converts hardest
observed_examples: A French Bulldog on a Skateboard
German Shepherd Montage For Dog Lovers
Nordic Wolf Viking
A Highland Cow Drawing
themes.note: Breed-specific beats generic, same as every other market. Highland cow is a distinctly strong UK motif.

themes.name: Retro British TV & film
observed_examples: MONKEY MAGIC T-SHIRT Mens Retro TV Show 70's 80's Martial Arts Chinese Fantasy
THE OLD GREY WHISTLE TEST T-Shirt Mens Retro Music TV Programme Show Vinyl Lp
FORK HANDLES T-Shirt FOUR CANDLES - Mens Funny Two Ronnies Sketch Show
TISWAS T-Shirt Mens Funny Retro Classic TV Programme Show
themes.note: DO NOT COPY THIS ONE. Monkey Magic, The Prisoner, Tiswas, The Old Grey Whistle Test, Dukes of Hazzard, Only Fools and Horses are all live rights. The competitors are carrying real exposure here. If you want the nostalgia demand, build era aesthetics - '1970s British Saturday morning', 'analogue TV test card' - not titles.

themes.name: Viking / Norse
themes.audience: Norse mythology, gym culture, tattoo culture, historical reenactment
observed_examples: Odins Celtic Raven Viking Thor Ragnar Norse
Viking Symbol Vegvisir Grey Gym
Son of Odin Valhalla Viking Norse Mythology
Dragons North Viking Valhalla Thor Odin
themes.note: Rune and symbol names (Vegvisir, Valknut, Yggdrasil, Mjolnir) are a free long-tail keyword grid.

themes.name: Birthday & milestone age
themes.audience: Gift buyers; the single most mechanical grid in the catalogue
observed_examples: 47th Birthday T-Shirt Mens 1979 Funny Premium Legend Since 47 Year old Top
60 Year Old Banger Birthday 60th Year Old
Vintage Year 61st Birthday 1965
Birth of Legends 53rd Birthday 1973
themes.note: PURE GRID. ~8 phrasings x 80 ages (18-98) x auto-computed birth year x 17 garments = 10,880 listings from 8 templates. Regenerate the birth year every January or the whole grid goes stale.

grid_themes_ranked.why: One flag treatment applied to every nation. Zero incremental art cost.
Pure string templating; birth year computed from age.
Named runes and symbols are a free long-tail keyword grid.
Deepest genuine demand in the UK eBay tee market.
Stacks with biker, metal and Viking - one motif serves three themes.
